leads.name: Thornythwaite Fell yew
leads.place: Thornythwaite Fell above Thorneythwaite Farm, Borrowdale
leads.source: https://www.ancient-yew.org/yew_trees/thornythwaite-fell-5263/ (2003 Michael Graham; 2024 Paul Greenwood and Bryony Smith, girth 610 cm around two fragments)
leads.reason: no coordinate published in AYG, no exact pin in reach; described as inaccessible fell tree. No photo or exact pin in reach. Strong deepen candidate for Borrowdale if a position surfaces.

leads.name: Wordsworth's yews, St Oswald's Grasmere
leads.source: https://www.ancient-yew.org/yew_tree_database/grasmere/ (8 notable yews, girths 249 to 399 cm, Tim Hills 2014); church website per search says Wordsworth planted eight
leads.reason: a group of 'notable' not ancient yews; AYG doubts the planting claim (too thick for 1800s planting if Wordsworth's). Single trunk not identified. Possible ensemble entry if a source names the yew by his grave.

leads.name: Muncaster Castle yew
leads.source: https://www.ancient-yew.org/yew_trees/muncaster-2768 (1997 visit, 455 cm at 3 ft, female, on small mound)
leads.reason: 1997 record only, no position inside the paid grounds, no life check.
